---

### Is your request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when…"

### Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

Any other approaches or features you've considered, and why you prefer the one
above.

### Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc.

### Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself and submit a PR
- [ ] I'd be open to a PR if someone else wants it
- [ ] I'm only suggesting the idea
